policy: All source migrations are recorded in the authenticated provider migration ledger. A source migration absent from provider history must be explicitly added here as pending and must block production until reviewed and applied. Provider-applied versions belong in remote-migrations.json; a ledger entry alone does not prove the migration's intended behavior has been independently verified.
